title: Varonis Achieves Snowflake Premier Partner Tier and Is Now Available on Snowflake Marketplace
summary: Varonis helps enterprises secure Snowflake environments so they can innovate fast with confidence.
body_markdown:
We're excited to share two milestones in our growing relationship with Snowflake. Varonis has achieved[Premier Partner](https://www.snowflake.com/en/why-snowflake/partners/all-partners/varonis-systems-inc/) status in the Snowflake Partner Network and is now available on the[Snowflake Marketplace.](https://app.snowflake.com/marketplace/listing/GZU6Z887E5A/varonis-varonis)


[AI agents](https://www.varonis.com/blog/agentic-ai-security-risk?hsLang=en) , copilots, and LLMs now read, write, and act on data flowing through data lakes, warehouses, and everywhere in between at machine speed. Varonis helps enterprises secure Snowflake environments so they can innovate fast with confidence.


[Varonis integrates with Snowflake](https://www.varonis.com/blog/snowflake-data-security?hsLang=en) to continuously analyze data sensitivity, who can access sensitive data, and how data is being used. With Varonis, organizations can confidently use Snowflake for analytics, collaboration, and AI while maintaining security and compliance controls.


Varonis and Snowflake are more connected than ever, helping customers secure the data and AI that power their business.


## What’s new with Varonis for Snowflake


Premier Partner Tier.


Reaching Premier Partner status


is further validation of Varonis' deep integration with Snowflake and enhances our ability to collaborate with Snowflake's teams on joint customer outcomes, co-selling, and roadmap alignment.


**Varonis on the Snowflake Marketplace.**


Snowflake customers can now find Varonis directly on the Snowflake Marketplace and apply a portion of their committed capacity to Varonis via the Snowflake Marketplace Capacity Drawdown (MCD) program.


## Why customers turn to Varonis to secure Snowflake


Organizations adopt Snowflake to accelerate their data and AI initiatives. Rather than stitching together separate systems for storage, warehousing, and analytics, teams can consolidate and spend less time on infrastructure and more time analyzing data, collaborating, and building AI applications and agents.


Security is important, but it must be balanced with the speed and flexibility that they adopted Snowflake for in the first place.


Customers adopt Varonis for Snowflake for the visibility and guardrails needed to move fast while staying secure, and map Snowflake permissions to clearly understand what data exists, who can access it, and how it is used.


That's exactly why customers like Webster Bank use Varonis to secure Snowflake:


"Security shouldn't slow the business. It should enable it. Varonis lets us adopt AI faster and safer."


**Patricia Voight,** CISO, Webster Bank


## Varonis and Snowflake: Better together


Varonis makes it easy to secure Snowflake environments without slowing innovation. Varonis provides the visibility and control security teams need to know where sensitive data lives, ensure access matches actual need, and catch misuse before it becomes a breach.


-


[Automatically discover and classify sensitive data](https://www.varonis.com/platform/data-discovery-and-classification?hsLang=en) .


Varonis discovers and classifies sensitive data across every Snowflake database, schema, table, and column to pinpoint PII, PHI, financial data, and more.


-


Map effective permissions for every user. Varonis cuts through nested role inheritance to show exactly who can reach what, and right-sizes access automatically.


-


Detect and stop threat. Varonis builds[behavioral baselines for every user and system](https://www.varonis.com/platform/data-centric-ueba?hsLang=en) and monitors the access patterns that indicate risk. From a compromised account to an insider threat to an AI system reaching data it shouldn't, Varonis provides real-time, contextual alerts, rather than noise.


## A stronger foundation for what's next


It's now faster and easier than ever to secure your Snowflake environment with Varonis and start gaining visibility and control without slowing down data and AI initiatives.


If you're running sensitive data in Snowflake, there's no better time to see where you stand. Varonis offers a free[Snowflake Data Risk Assessment](https://info.varonis.com/en/data-risk-assessment?hsLang=en) that shows you, within 24 hours, where your sensitive data lives, who can access it, and what's putting it at risk.
